questions.prompt: Which of these countries shares a border with South Africa?

hints.nudge: Two countries are neighbours when you can walk from one into the other. Picture South Africa on the globe and look at what it touches.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “Climate” part of the South Africa article.

questions.proof: There is a desert in the southern Namib in the farthest northwest and subtropical climate in the east along the Mozambique border and the Indian Ocean.

questions.prompt: Which language is an official language of South Africa?

hints.nudge: An official language is the one used in schools, courts and government. The other three are spoken in other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “Society and culture” part of the South Africa article.

questions.proof: Urban blacks normally speak English or Afrikaans in addition to their native tongue.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “South Africa is next to Namibia, _____, Zimbabwe, Mozambique, and Eswatini, but encloses Lesotho.”

hints.nudge: In the sentence the missing word sits beside “Namibia”. It names one thing, not an action.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the South Africa article.

questions.proof: South Africa is next to Namibia, Botswana, Zimbabwe, Mozambique, and Eswatini, but encloses Lesotho.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “The developed part of the economy is similar to that of most nations with wealth (for example, New Zealand or _____).”

hints.nudge: In the sentence the missing word sits beside “Zealand”. It names one thing, not an action.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “Economy” part of the South Africa article.

questions.proof: The developed part of the economy is similar to that of most nations with wealth (for example, New Zealand or Australia).

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “He was its president from _____ until 1999.”

hints.nudge: It is a year in the twentieth century.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the South Africa article.

questions.proof: He was its president from 1994 until 1999.
